sentence: This project tries to find out how lung scarring can be reversed in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, a lung disease.
This project offers laboratory assays and human blood and mucosal specimens to support research on HIV prevention, treatment and remission.
This project offers imaging tools, including fluorescence microscopy and electron microscopy, to support cancer research.
This project tries to find out how energy metabolism controls a ubiquitin ligase in mitochondria and how it works in peroxisomes.
This project gives human tissue specimens and biofluids such as blood and urine to scientists to help them understand the causes of disease, especially cancer.
This project uses magnetic resonance imaging to see sodium and the lymphatic system in people with lymphedema or lipedema.
This project tries to find out how early maternal-offspring interactions such as breast milk shape mucosal immunity and gluten sensitivity during the neonatal period.
This project studies how neuroinflammation and stress affect reading development in children with dyslexia.
This project tries to find out what makes people respond differently to pain treatments such as placebo, using machine learning.
This project tries to find out which genetic and environmental factors shape skin and hair phenotypes in Africans.
This project studies how secreted factors from one type of fibroblast suppress breast tumors.
This project builds an open source framework that helps users prioritize genes and variants in cancer.
This project builds machine-learning algorithms that use images to identify the organisms causing microbial keratitis at the point-of-care.
This project provides support for medical imaging and cancer research, including shared databases of images, biospecimens and clinical data.
This project studies how influenza spreads between ferrets using transmission experiments, viral load measurements and machine learning.
This project builds a drug delivery platform that uses focused ultrasound to release engineered exosomes at a specific site.
This project develops structures for lossless ion manipulations that separate biomacromolecules and soft-land them for characterization.
This project screens libraries of small molecules to find antivirals that act directly against viruses.
This project builds a blood-based biomarker followed by imaging and sampling of the fallopian tube to detect ovarian cancer early.
This project develops gene therapy that edits hematopoietic stem cells in vivo to make them resistant to HIV.
